error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.init.zh-CN: 网络允许列表必须填写完整协议、主机和端口，不能包含路径或查询参数
error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.init.en: The network allowlist requires complete schemes, hosts, and ports, without paths or query parameters.

error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.reso.zh-CN: 无法解析连接地址，请检查地址或稍后重试。
error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.reso.en: The connection address could not be resolved. Check it or try again later.

error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.look.zh-CN: 当前连接请求较多，请稍后重试。
error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.look.en: Too many connections are being requested. Try again later.
The connection address could not be resolved.

error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.time.zh-CN: 地址解析已取消或超过允许时间。
error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.time.en: Address resolution was cancelled or timed out.

error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.pars.zh-CN: 请通过凭据配置提供认证信息，不要写入连接地址。
error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.pars.en: Provide authentication through credential settings, not in the connection address.

error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.deni.zh-CN: 连接地址不在允许的访问范围内，请检查地址或联系部署管理员。
error.network.outboundAddressPolicy.deni.en: This address is outside the allowed access scope. Check it or contact the deployment administrator.

error.network.restrictedHttpClient.init..zh-CN: 连接超时必须在一百二十秒以内
error.network.restrictedHttpClient.init..en: The connection timeout must not exceed 120 seconds.

error.network.restrictedHttpClient.remai.zh-CN: 连接已取消或超过允许时间。
error.network.restrictedHttpClient.remai.en: The connection was cancelled or timed out.

error.network.restrictedHttpClient.execu.zh-CN: 连接返回了不支持的跳转，请检查插件地址。
error.network.restrictedHttpClient.execu.en: The connection returned an unsupported redirect. Check the plugin address.

error.network.restrictedHttpClient.execu.zh-CN: 连接跳转不能保留本次请求，请填写最终服务地址。
error.network.restrictedHttpClient.execu.en: The redirect cannot preserve this request. Enter the final service address.
